patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-contrast imagery and video sections are used as visual anchors, alternating with structured product grids.
Overlapping, distressed, and extremely large sans-serif typography is used for hero and section titles, often interacting with background images.
A stark black and white base is consistently contrasted with vibrant, saturated accent colors (pinks, reds) for key calls to action and graphic elements.
Scroll-triggered reveals cause content blocks to slide up and fade into view from the bottom as they enter the viewport.
Section breaks and the footer incorporate distressed, torn-paper graphic elements, adding a raw, tactile texture to the design.

technique_notes: The top navigation bar is implemented as a sticky header, maintaining brand presence and navigation access throughout the scroll.
The hero section features a large, layered typographic element that appears to parallax or fade out as the user scrolls, revealing the content below.
Content sections are animated to slide up and fade in from the bottom as they become visible in the viewport, creating a dynamic reveal experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very oversized, condensed, and often distressed display headings (~6-8x body) with smaller, legible sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners dominate, with subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and product cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, with airy, full-bleed hero and video sections, and a more dense, grid-like arrangement for product listings.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large, distressed, and often overlapping typography, combined with full-bleed, high-fashion imagery and video, creates a raw, edgy, and editorial feel that breaks from typical e-commerce layouts. The torn paper graphic elements also add to this unique aesthetic.
